quarantine.oracle: Parsing the reordered header produces the same reference dictionary as the original; all alignment records resolve to the same contig indices.

evidence.quote: Each @SQ line defines a reference sequence. The order of @SQ lines is not significant; the reference dictionary is keyed by the SN tag.

quarantine.oracle: Parsing the shuffled header produces the same set of comment lines; the order of @CO lines does not affect alignment record interpretation.

evidence.quote: @CO lines are one-line comments that are ignored by the parser. They have no ordering semantics.

quarantine.mr_name: SAM optional tag field permutation invariance
quarantine.oracle: Parsing the permuted alignment record yields the same tag-value dictionary as the original; all tag keys and values are preserved.

evidence.quote: Each alignment line may have optional fields in the format TAG:TYPE:VALUE. The order of optional fields is not significant.

quarantine.oracle: Parsing the shuffled @HD line yields the same header version, sorting order, and grouping as the original; TAG:VALUE pair order within @HD is not significant.

evidence.quote: The @HD line has tags VN, SO, GO, and SS. The order of these tags is not specified.

quarantine.oracle: Parsing the shuffled @SQ line yields the same reference sequence metadata (SN, LN, M5, UR, SP) as the original; TAG:VALUE pair order within @SQ is not significant.

evidence.quote: Each @SQ line has tags SN, LN, M5, UR, SP, and AH. The order of these tags is not specified.

quarantine.oracle: Parsing the shuffled @RG line yields the same read-group metadata (ID, SM, LB, PU, PL, CN, DS, DT, FO, KS, LB, PG, PI, PM, PU) as the original; TAG:VALUE pair order within @RG is not significant.

evidence.quote: Each @RG line has tags ID, SM, LB, PU, PL, CN, DS, DT, FO, KS, PG, PI, PM. The order of these tags is not specified.

quarantine.oracle: Parsing the shuffled @PG line yields the same program record metadata (ID, PN, VN, CL, PP, DS) as the original; TAG:VALUE pair order within @PG is not significant.

evidence.quote: Each @PG line has tags ID, PN, VN, CL, PP, and DS. The order of these tags is not specified.

quarantine.mr_name: CIGAR-SEQ length mismatch must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH on the malformed record; silent acceptance or silent record-drop is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The sum of lengths of the M/I/S/=/X operations shall equal the length of SEQ.

quarantine.mr_name: Flag bit 0x4 mapped/unmapped contradiction must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when FLAG 0x4 is set on a record with RNAME != '*' and POS > 0; silent acceptance is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: Bit 0x4: segment unmapped. If set, RNAME is '*' and POS is 0.

quarantine.mr_name: Optional tag illegal type character must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when an optional tag's type character is not one of A, i, f, Z, H, or B; silent acceptance is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The type character must be one of A, i, f, Z, H, or B.

quarantine.mr_name: TLEN sign consistency violation must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: All SUTs must REJECT or CRASH when paired reads of a template have same-signed TLEN values instead of opposite-signed; silent acceptance is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: For paired reads, the two reads of a template must have equal magnitude but opposite sign TLEN values.
